key_decisions: USER DECISION (this session): single-op models (PiD, Boogu Edit, Qwen Edit) render ONE chip rather than no strip - always selected, greyed out when the prompt box holds no image. This closes the open question carried by the previous handoff.

USER DECISION (this session): Tab does NOT open the radial for now; it opens the model overlay directly. The radial machinery must be LEFT READY - later Tab opens a ring whose items are Models and Apps.
USER DECISION (this session): no component-gallery demo for MpiModelPicker (it needs a live model list; a demo would be half-fake).
USER DECISION (this session): updating `.claude/rules/` for this card is APPROVED.

`_refreshOpDropdown` was DELETED rather than renamed - once the dropdown half went, its body was a single line. All ten call sites now call `_refreshOpStrip` directly, which guards `!model` AFTER clearing the slot (strictly better than the old early return).

The popup is parameters-only in the literal sense: the LoRA/upscale gear left too. That killed the PromptBox's `settings` emit, so both Blocks' `pb.on('settings')` listeners were removed and the dead `showSettings` prop went with them. `model.showSettings === false` still matters - the PICKER now reads it to omit the LoRA button on a model that configures nothing.

MpiModelPicker owns NO model logic. Each Block mounts its own instance, hands it the workspace-filtered installed list, and applies the pick - the same ownership split the op strip uses. Only one Block is ever alive (navigation destroys the other), which is the same assumption `workspace:set-operation` already relies on.

The LoRA & Upscale control inside a tile is a `<span role="button">`, not a button - a <button> may not nest inside the tile <button>. Its click is intercepted in the CAPTURE phase (the tile's own listener sits on the inner element and would otherwise fire first) and re-emitted as a `settings` event, because a Compound may not import the MpiModelSettings Compound.

BUG THE LIVE RUN CAUGHT: the picker's full-bleed content painted over MpiOverlay's own X - visible but unclickable, Escape still worked, so a static read would have shipped it. Fixed with the same lift the Model Library needed: `.mpi-overlay--body:has(.mpi-model-picker) .mpi-overlay__close { z-index: 35 }`.
